name: Preachers
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred role of preachers as anointed messengers who are to be protected and honored, as seen in Psalms 105:15. God promises to provide pastors who will shepherd His people with knowledge and understanding (Jeremiah 3:15). The Great Commission commands believers to preach the gospel universally (Mark 16:15), empowered by the Holy Spirit to be effective witnesses (Acts 1:8). Additionally, preachers are called to live consistently with their teachings, exemplifying integrity in their conduct (Romans 2:21).
